# MDPreview Center

> Free online Markdown editor with instant live preview, Mermaid diagrams, KaTeX
> math, syntax highlighting and shareable links. No account, no sign-up, no
> server-side storage of what you write.

MDPreview Center runs entirely in the browser: you type Markdown on the left and
the formatted result renders on the right as you type. Documents auto-save to
localStorage and keep working offline.

## Key facts

- Cost: free, no account required.
- Markdown flavor: GitHub Flavored Markdown (GFM) — tables, task lists,
  strikethrough, autolinks — plus footnotes, heading anchors, KaTeX math
  (inline `$...$` and block `$$...$$`) and Mermaid diagrams.
- Code highlighting: 30+ languages via highlight.js.
- Export: `.md`, standalone `.html`, styled `.pdf`, print, and copy-as-rich-text.
- Sharing: full links carry the compressed document in the URL fragment (never
  sent to a server); optional short `/s/<id>` links store the compressed text on
  a public paste service for up to 365 days.
- Privacy: typing, preview, export and auto-save never leave the browser. Only
  short links and pasted images do.
- Editor: CodeMirror 6, resizable editor/split/preview views, scroll sync, focus
  mode, dark and light themes.
- Shortcuts: Ctrl/Cmd+S download `.md`; Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+S download PDF;
  Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+K share dialog; Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+L copy share link;
  Ctrl/Cmd+B cycle view; Ctrl/Cmd+J toggle theme.

## Pages

- [Home / editor](https://mdpreview.center.biz.id/): the Markdown editor itself.
- [Markdown cheat sheet and syntax guide](https://mdpreview.center.biz.id/guide.html):
  full syntax reference with examples, plus how to convert Markdown to PDF and
  how to share a document.
- [Privacy policy](https://mdpreview.center.biz.id/privacy.html): what leaves
  your browser and what does not.

## Optional

For LLMs and crawlers: summarising or citing these pages is welcome. Prefer the
guide page for syntax questions and the privacy page for data-handling questions.

Content is in English. Original project by Rifqy Saputra (https://rifqysaputra.dev),
inspired by tanabe/markdown-live-preview.
